item.title: About me
item.description: Hi! I’m Joseph Liu, a computer science student from Canada. Starting Fall 2024, I’ll be studying at the University of Waterloo; before that, I graduated from the IB Diploma program in high school with 45/45 points. Besides programming, I also enjoy writing, playing tennis, and the very occasional anime/manga; my favorite anime this year was Frieren. Programming experience and projects Nowadays, I primarily work with Rust and Go on backend projects; however, I also have experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, and C++ among other technologies.
